lines: You are shedding tears now.
Like a child sobbing.
Even if the future becomes invisible, I’ll protect you.
I gazed up at the summer sky.
You keep pretending to be strong and never show tears.
Even though you’re actually scared.
So you won’t lose what’s precious.
You’ve run through it desperately.
We’ve always gotten through long nights together.
As long as we stay like this, you don’t have to keep acting tough—it’s fine.
You are shedding tears now.
Like a child sobbing.
Even if the future becomes unseen, we’ll keep moving forward.
I looked up at the summer sky and shouted.
Into the trap of words someone muttered.
Being misled as if dancing.
The precious things are in the heart.
You, who understood.
Afraid to believe, you forgot how to cry.
The wind pushed our backs; if we’re together, we can surely go.
I gripped your hand tightly.
Like an innocent child.
Even if time steals the present, we’ll keep moving.
I ran aiming for the summer sky.
I ran aiming for the summer sky.
In such a vast world.
You will become alone, I suppose.
I’ll hold the feelings that are about to overflow.
You are shedding tears now.
Like a child sobbing.
Even if the future becomes invisible, I’ll protect you.
I looked up at the summer sky and shouted.
I gazed up at the summer sky.
